verdict.rationale: Square's product page says merchants can accept contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone. The developer docs add a Tap to Pay on iPhone guide in the Mobile Payments SDK, so phone-only acceptance is documented first-party. Missing for 10: evidence of Tap to Pay on Android or other off-the-shelf phones, an explicit statement that no reader purchase is required, device/eligibility requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
